name: Ludman no Yabou
source:
Bianca decides to "participate" in an erotic rite with Ludman to earn her beloved husband the coveted Sky Shield item.
She promises no kissing and no sex, and the newlyweds believe it... but Ludman's lewd training compromises that plan quickly.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE078478.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
比安卡决定与鲁德曼“参加”一场色情仪式，为深爱的丈夫赢得梦寐以求的天空之盾。
她保证不会接吻，也不会发生性关系，新婚夫妇都相信了这一点……但鲁德曼的下流训练很快就让这个计划泡汤。
